(2) Several watches are lined up on the table. The man picks up a silver watch with a blue dial and examines it closely, turning it over to show the back. (3) The man holds the silver watch up towards the camera, smiling and gesturing. The cameraman in the foreground adjusts his camera lens while looking at the man. (4) Extreme close-up shots show the intricate details of the watch face, including the brand name 'MIDO', and the mechanical movement visible through the transparent case back. (5) The man hands the silver watch to the cameraman, who is now fully in frame. The cameraman looks surprised and touches his face with his hand. (6) The scene shifts to a different indoor location with warm lighting. A group of people is gathered. A person presents a large guitar case containing a red electric guitar. People are clapping and cheering. (7) Back in the studio, the cameraman is now wearing the silver watch on his left wrist. He talks to the man in the denim shirt, occasionally touching the watch and his own head.
